court: Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit

issues.label: Distinction between claim and theory of entitlement
issues.why: Whether direct and presumptive service connection are separate claims or alternative theories determines if the Board fully adjudicated the claim.

issues.label: Board's duty to adjudicate all raised theories
issues.why: The court must decide whether the Board was obligated to address the direct service-connection theory reasonably raised by the evidence and testimony.

issues.label: Mootness of the appeal
issues.why: Central question is whether granting presumptive benefits rendered the direct-basis claim moot as the Veterans Court held.

issues.label: Effective date consequences of direct vs. presumptive grant
issues.why: A direct grant could yield an earlier effective date (2011) unavailable under the PACT Act's post-enactment limitation.

issues.label: PACT Act effective-date limitation scope
issues.why: Court must determine whether § 5110(g) and § 3.114(a) bar earlier effective dates only for presumptive benefits, not direct ones.

issues.label: Downstream issue characterization of effective date
issues.why: Whether effective date is truly a separate downstream issue requiring its own appeal or intertwined with the unadjudicated theory.

issues.label: Availability of separate appeal remedy
issues.why: Whether Mr. Hepler can adequately preserve his rights through a future effective-date appeal affects the mootness analysis.

issues.label: Concrete injury and live controversy
issues.why: Court must assess whether Hepler retains a personal stake given potential earlier benefits despite the presumptive grant.

issues.label: Benefit-of-the-doubt and duty to assist
issues.why: Pro-veteran principles may require the Board to resolve favorable direct-basis evidence rather than defer it.

issues.label: Board's remand-to-RO instruction adequacy
issues.why: Whether the Board's note directing the RO to consider direct-basis evidence satisfies its adjudicatory obligations.

issues.label: Jurisdiction of Veterans Court and Federal Circuit
issues.why: Court must confirm authority to review the mootness dismissal and any legal interpretation questions presented.

issues.label: Precedential effect on future Board decisions
issues.why: Judge Bartley's dissent flags that the ruling is being cited to excuse non-adjudication of theories in other cases.

issues.label: Standard of review for mootness dismissal
issues.why: The applicable standard governs how the reviewing court evaluates the Veterans Court's legal conclusion.

issues.label: Adequacy of Board's statement of reasons
issues.why: The Board's failure to expressly grant, deny, or remand the direct claim may violate reasons-or-bases requirements.
